description: Return the latest readings of ten factor indicators and TD Sequential 9 (daily and weekly) for the S&P 500 (SPX), Nasdaq-100 (NDX) and PHLX Semiconductor (SOX) price indices: value, reading, bullish/neutral/bearish signal and the rule's bands, with each rule's source and its 2005–2026 S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 evidence. Signals are rule readings, not forecasts; several are contrarian, and SOX has no implied-volatility readings. Five-year histories are at /api/market/indicators.
name: get_market_indicators

asOf.description: Latest upstream quote timestamp among the three indices; not necessarily a session close.

generatedAt.description: Time this snapshot was calculated; cached responses retain this timestamp.

evidence.description: What followed each state from 2005 to 2026 on the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100; SOX is untested.

bands.description: Bullish is checked first; any other value is neutral.

bearish.description: Holds at `above` or higher, or at `below` or lower.

bullish.description: Holds at `above` or higher, or at `below` or lower.

reading.description: The value in words, as shown on /indicators.

value.description: The quantity the bands test; a fraction when unit is percent (0.05 is 5%).

NDX.description: Null when a series the rule needs is missing, e.g. implied volatility for SOX.
